affordance_in_statement: For a calibration tube connecting lens u and lens v, its baseline frequency is calculated as the least common multiple (lcm) of the focal values of lens u and lens v. The focal value of a lens i is defined as 3 c_i + 1, where c_i is its assigned polarization mode. To successfully filter out glare, there must exist some valid assignment ... such that for every calibration tube, its baseline frequency is exactly 28.
